## CI triage: `real_bug` (91% confidence)
Workflow: CI

`app/auth.py` now returns the user id instead of the user object, so the login endpoint returns 500.

**Evidence**
- `AssertionError: expected 200 got 500` (log) — the test fails on the response status
- `return session.user.id` (diff) — the changed return value no longer matches the caller

**Next step:** Restore the user object or update the caller to use the id.
